verdict.rationale: OCI's documentation shows budgets that set soft limits on spending, with alerts that warn when you might exceed the budget. That covers the budget and alert parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows documented spend anomaly detection, and "soft limits" means the budget does not by itself stop the bill from growing. Missing for 10: documented cost anomaly detection, hard spend caps or automated enforcement, evidence that alerts work by default from day one, independent or hands-on corroboration.
